introHtml: Semi fitted shirts offer a modern silhouette that is tailored but not tight, making them ideal for professional settings where a neat appearance matters. Unlike classic or relaxed fits, semi fitted styles follow the body's contours without being restrictive, allowing for ease of movement throughout the workday. Whether you're ordering branded dress shirts for your sales team or henleys for a company outing, this cut provides a polished look that suits a variety of body types. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for lasting brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom semi fitted shirts in a range of colors featuring embroidered logos on the chest
